text:
Leafy Plus members get a **90-day** Plant Care Guarantee, counted from the delivery date. This applies to plants ordered while the membership is active. Standard customers get 30 days.

If a plant dies or declines significantly despite reasonable care, we send one free replacement of the same plant (or store credit if it's out of stock). To claim, go to "My Orders" within the window and upload at least two photos (whole plant and a close-up). A Plant Care Specialist will review it within 2 business days, and you don't need to send the plant back.
